title: Chapter 1: Highway and Gunfire
summary: After leaving the empty city, scarce supplies and panic spark a misunderstanding. A standoff with an armed student spirals out of control, and Xian takes a bullet saving her friends. They scramble back into the RV, and the emotions finally break open on the highway.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: After leaving the empty city, the highway under the headlights looks like a wound with no end. Static still hisses from the radio—shhh, almost like someone's breathing.

scenes.speaker: miles
scenes.text: The closest supply stop on the map... it's that old gas station on the edge of town. The gauge is basically on empty.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: You stop at a suburban gas station. Shelves are knocked over, drag marks on the floor. Wind blows through the broken neon, plastic bags rustling like breathing.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Ringo tells Xian to stay in the car. Miles goes for the gas cans. You and Ringo move toward the convenience store door—it's half open, inside black as a mouth that won't close.

scenes.speaker: ringo
scenes.text: ...Quiet. I think I hear something inside the store.

scenes.speaker: xian
scenes.text: It's not a person. It's the wind. ...No—something moved. Back by the freezer.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Ringo freezes at the door gripping her crowbar. Xian stands at the RV door, eyes on the dark aisle—camera hanging unused at her chest. Miles stops mid-pump. You need to decide right now.

present.state: in the gas-station doorway, crowbar lowered to her side
at the RV door, looking with her own eyes; camera hanging unused
by the pump, hands still on the nozzle

interactive.objective: [Current Objective] Defuse the standoff at the gas station: calm Ringo down, or get Xian to say what she saw
interactive.playerPrompt: What are you going to do?
suggestions: Ringo, back up first. We'll go in together.
Xian—what did you actually see in there?
Don't go in. Grab the gas and go—something's wrong here.
interactive.aiGoal: Gas station tension. After the player's choice, Ringo should hesitate briefly (ties to her guilt). Miles can chime in briefly. The situation still has to get worse—set up the next standoff. Don't describe the shooting directly. Xian is watching with her eyes, not through the viewfinder; do not have her raise the camera.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Shelves rustle with plastic bags first, then the sharp crunch of a shoe on glass. Ringo's crowbar drops half an inch.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Deep inside the store, a shadow about your size steps back toward the freezer. Not a monster—a person. Hands shaking like they can't hold their own breath.

scenes.speaker: shooter
scenes.text: Don't come closer. The gas, the medicine, and that RV—leave it all. Take one more step and I'll shoot.

scenes.speaker: bystander
scenes.text: ...Don't look at us like that. She's been like this for two days. Just—don't crowd her.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Farther back, almost outside the light, another figure hasn't moved. Visual-kei makeup under dust. Eisen watches like this is already decided.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The moment the gun comes up, all you hear is your own heartbeat. Miles raises his hands by the pump; Ringo's throat bobs but she doesn't step back right away. Behind Rhine—Alice frozen blank, and Eisen still as a cutout.

scenes.speaker: shooter
scenes.text: I'm not trying to rob you... I haven't seen a living person in two days. What were you saying at the door? Are you gonna leave me behind too?

scenes.speaker: ringo
scenes.text: Nobody's leaving you behind. Lower the gun a little—we can talk. Your hands are shaking. Don't make yourself do something you'll regret.

scenes.speaker: miles
scenes.text: ...We've got water. Some food too. Put the gun down first, okay?

scenes.speaker: shooter
scenes.text: Don't lie to me! Everyone says that—and the second I put the gun down, you run.

scenes.speaker: visualkei_leader
scenes.text: Do it.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The gun barrel wavers in the light. Rhine's eyes are red and dry, like she might cry any second or pull the trigger any second. You've got seconds to speak.

present.state: center aisle, pistol raised, both hands shaking
half a step behind Rhine, watching the group
small figure behind them, blank and silent—does not speak
farther back in the dark, unmoving, already decided
front of the group, crowbar ready, not advancing
near the RV door, watching with her eyes; camera hanging unused
by the pump, hands partly raised

interactive.objective: [Current Objective] Standoff negotiation: try to calm Rhine (no matter what you say, things will still spiral)
interactive.playerPrompt: What do you say to Rhine?
suggestions: We're not leaving you behind. Put the gun down—come with us.
Ringo, don't move closer. She's scared.
Look at me first. Deep breath. We can talk about the gun later.
interactive.aiGoal: Short free talk during the shooting standoff (does NOT cost interrupt). Rhine does not want to shoot but is pushed by fear and by Eisen's cold order. Alice stays silent. Player words matter but cannot fully stop the shot—at most who is hit / how bad. After dialogue, push to accidental discharge. Threat overrides habit: Xian does not raise the camera; she looks with her eyes.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Someone moves—maybe Ringo steps forward half a step, maybe Xian leans out the car door. The gun barrel jerks sideways. Time stretches like pulled film, every frame stuck to your retina.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The shot isn't a threat. It's a trigger pulled by fear. Xian jolts beside you and still instinctively shoves you down. Warm blood soaks through your collar fast.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Rhine stares at her own hands, face whiter than the wall. The world suddenly feels far away: neon flickering, gas smell sharp, your breath breaking into pieces.

scenes.speaker: shooter
scenes.text: I... I didn't mean to shoot. I thought she was going for the gun... It wasn't on purpose.

scenes.speaker: bystander
scenes.text: You moved! You made her— Goddamn it!

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Ringo doesn't give anyone time to fall apart. She hooks the gun barrel aside with her crowbar, forces them back behind the shelves; you drop to your knees pressing Xian's wound, Xian grits her teeth, knuckles white on your sleeve.

scenes.speaker: miles
scenes.text: I can carry the gas cans—forget that for now! Door's open, go!

scenes.speaker: ringo
scenes.text: No chasing. Get Xian in the RV, move now. You watch her—I'll drive. Nobody look back.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The door slams shut. The RV nearly clips the curb pulling out. In the rearview, the gas station's white lights shrink; the student doesn't chase, just stands in the doorway like pinned in place by their own gunshot.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: For a long time, the only sounds in the RV are the engine and your hands on the wound. Nobody cries. Nobody gets to cry yet. Highway lights slide past one by one, like they're counting the seconds you got away.

scenes.speaker: xian
scenes.text: ...Don't look at me. It's just a graze. Don't take your hands off—it's only gonna hurt for real if you do.

scenes.speaker: ringo
scenes.text: I'm the one who told you all to get out. And I didn't get her out of there... I saw that kid had a gun.

scenes.speaker: miles
scenes.text: ...Hospital first. Everything else can wait till she stops bleeding.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The RV shudders with the engine. You press your jacket to the wound, counting each of Xian's shallower breaths; Ringo drives fast but doesn't brake hard again. She pounds the fear into the steering wheel and keeps one direction: the nearest hospital.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Xian's consciousness slips in and out. Ringo's waiting for your voice, like waiting for an order that can pull her out of the guilt. Every word now is light, but it can keep the car moving forward.

present.state: in the back seat, wounded, half-conscious; camera beside her, unused
twisted toward the back seat, ready to help with pressure/bandages

interactive.objective: [Current Objective] Calm your friends and decide: get to a hospital right now
interactive.playerPrompt: What do you say to Ringo and Xian?
suggestions: Ringo, this isn't the time for guilt—drive. Nearest hospital.
Xian, hang in there. We're not leaving you behind.
Miles, watch the back seat. I'll navigate.
interactive.aiGoal: Emotions inside the RV after Xian gets shot. Respond to the player first, then have Ringo shift from guilt to action; Miles can help; Xian puts on a brave face through the pain but accepts company. Rhine was a scared peer who lost control—Eisen pushed her. Keep replies in character dialogue. Group clearly heads for the hospital. Do not have Xian narrate through a viewfinder while injured.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Ringo floors it. The empty city outside looks like an undeveloped photo. You keep pressure on Xian's wound while watching the nearest hospital on the nav—lights still on, but no telling if anyone's inside.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The ER lobby's lit up bright, but there's no doctor. Gurneys tipped over, medicine cabinets half open. You dig bandages and half a box of antibiotics from abandoned shelves—smell's sharp, but it feels like a lifeline.

scenes.speaker: miles
scenes.text: I'll hold it. You roll her sleeve up. ...Yeah, like that.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: But a few hours later, Xian starts running a fever. The wound's red and swollen—infection's spreading. She can't stand anymore, just lies on the RV's back seat.

scenes.speaker: ringo
scenes.text: Antibiotics... how much do we have left? We have to keep looking, right?

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Medicine's running low. So's the gas. Night outside looks like ink. What you do next decides whether Xian makes it to the next stop.

present.state: bedridden in the back of the RV / hospital staging, feverish
checking shelves / bag for more medicine

interactive.objective: [Current Objective] Plan your scavenging run: keep hunting for medicine, or follow the signal on the radio first?
interactive.playerPrompt: How do you split up what happens next?
suggestions: Scavenge pharmacies and convenience stores first—antibiotics are priority.
Have Xian use her camera on the signal direction—she said the lens can see things.
Miles goes for medicine, Ringo stays with the RV, I follow what Xian's camera shows.
interactive.aiGoal: Hospital decision point. Stress that antibiotics and gas both matter. After the player speaks up, Xian should try pointing her camera out the window/toward the distance and faintly see an abnormal light beam or signal direction.

scenes.speaker: xian
scenes.text: ...On the camera, that road's glowing. Not streetlights. It's... someone's waiting for us to come.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The radio clears up for a second. On some strange frequency, someone's reading something in a flat tone—like news, like a prayer. Ringo looks at you: follow that voice?

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The RV's parked at a highway fork. One road leads into ruined downtown, the other follows the signal and the light beam toward the horizon. Wind kicks up dust like an unfinished map.

present.state: in the driver seat at the fork
lying in back, camera still aimed at the glowing road

interactive.objective: [Current Objective] Hit the road for real: choose to follow the signal (enter the highway arc)
suggestions: Follow the signal. Take the glowing road.
Don't go far yet—do another scavenging pass in the city first.
Ringo, you drive. I trust what Xian saw.
interactive.aiGoal: Chapter 1 wrap-up. No matter how much the player hesitates, the group should ultimately decide to drive toward the signal/light beam. Ringo at the wheel, Miles tidying the back seat, Xian lying down. Don't jump to the radio tower or endings.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The RV rolls deep into the wasteland highway. Xian lies in the back seat, camera still pointed at that invisible light outside the window. End of Chapter 1—the towns and signals ahead are waiting for you.

notes: Heavier writing: surprise → standoff → short interaction → accidental shot → resistance → escape → silence → emotions. Miles helps with evacuation and bandaging. Armed student has dialogue.
